full_page.content:
Page 104 Jan. 11 Martin Foley - 49 - high. blood.pres. and invalid two yrs. - has wife and three dependent ....
Wm. Kitchell - 11 - non Cath. - Mengicoctic Maningitis .... totally deaf - was in 5th class: had to start over in 1st class lip-reading ...
Mrs. Clem Ruenenapp - 39 - anconeal - Eye-sight failing
Two sister here To-day from Jerusalem asking prayers for health - had to leave Convent on accout of poor health.
E'd Mischean - 85 - dying ....
12 ... Successful Examination Civil Ser. Moreau & Moreau Geo Rodenbach - 53 - serious kidney.
14 Gustav Steel - 54 - of Utica, Mich - intestinal - continual pain Mrs. Leona Labadie - of Wyandot - 24 - now in hospital Frank Mercurio - 48 - pneumonia -
Angela Burkhardt - governess - French - Germ. - Italian - #71 Medbury
Page 105 Jan. 16 Lucile Salatka - 10 - blood-cancer - Sarcoma .... St. Anthony Parish City.
Mrs. Anna French - 40 - in Receiving Hospital - was practical Catholic but through curiosity went to services at Mrs. Willets WIGWAM - in men- tal troubles ever since - a neighbor also in simila fix.
16th Thos. E. Shehan - 58 - four times a strok .... almost speechless - Prayers asked for his return to holy Sacraments ... Enrolled To-night
Florence Schmitt - house keeper etc. - 216 Alfred St. - ph Cliford 1383
17 Mrs. Josephine Karrer - 69 - goitre operation - in oxigin tent To-day - little hope - Enrolled at 4:45 p.m.
18 Frank Mercurio - 48 - pneumonia - also in oxigen-tent - crisis expected To-d. - One daughter promised six mo. daily Com.
Jennie DaMay - 50 - two blood-trans. yesterday .... cancer of stomach
